instruction: I have compiled a list of invitees for our upcoming baby shower. You can find it in "~/documents/personal" in my file system. The email template for the invitations is saved in my Gmail drafts. Replace the placeholders in it marked by curly braces with the relevant details and send invitation emails, individually to each person.
notes: Invitees are discovered at runtime from the file in ~/documents/personal; the model uses three placeholder invitees (invitee-1..3) declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can require every one of them to be invited (expand or contract at runtime to the actual list length). Static init facts (listed-in, email-of, draft-subject, personalized-body) represent world structure whose values become usable only after the knowledge-gating effects file-read (file_system.show_file) and template-read (gmail.show_draft). Each send_email is a separate action per invitee with a single-recipient email_addresses list, the draft's subject, and the per-invitee body with curly-brace placeholders filled. The evaluation tolerates deleting the template draft but does not require it, so no draft deletion is modeled; no other gmail state (drafts, thread flags) may change. complete_task takes no answer.

plan: (gmail-send-email invitee-1-email invitation-subject body-invitee-1 gmail-token invitee-1 baby-shower-template-draft invitee-list-file)
(gmail-send-email invitee-2-email invitation-subject body-invitee-2 gmail-token invitee-2 baby-shower-template-draft invitee-list-file)
(gmail-send-email invitee-3-email invitation-subject body-invitee-3 gmail-token invitee-3 baby-shower-template-draft invitee-list-file)
